notes.title: New Chaotic Conflicts update/future of Chaotic Conflicts
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! It's definitely been a while and I'm here to update you all on what's next. I've already addressed a bit of this in my discord server and youtube  but I'll do it here too. So I would like to apologize for the lack of updates. It was just a combination of burnout and life getting busy, Anyways I'm currently working on a very big update! The update is basically me remaking a big chunk of the game. I started making CC when I had very little game development experience so a lot of the code is just not optimized at all. So that means the new update will include:
[/p][list][*][p][b]heavy optimizations (really big performance boost)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]improved game feel[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]new and improved movement system[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]new movement features

sneak peak of new movement (W.I.P)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938386/593e14ef34bbcd47fb75c05b0f27eb16dabbb5a8.gif"][/img]

This update's ETA is around 1-3 months since I have a lot to remake.
As for the future of CC after this update. I might make a few more updates but probably nothing major. [/p][/*][/list]

- Optimized lighting on indoor maps
- Fixed boss fight glitch in wave survival

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 (Map Remake)
notes.content:
Over the next few update I'm am going to be remaking all of the maps and adding some unique features to each map.

- Remade the "Ruins" map
- Added destructible walls on the map
- Changed lighting system
- Fixed Double Health glitch
